baseline.head: 36222c92c829a2ef08b71af2a3a3ff9a3c44b396
baseline.source: HEAD:proxy_v4/lib/V4.ps1 and HEAD:proxy_v4/state-v4.ps1 exported to an isolated %TEMP% sandbox

workingTreeDrift.observed: proxy_v4/apply-v4.ps1, lib/V4.ps1, rollback-v4.ps1 and state-v4.ps1 were modified by another process during the review; proxy_v6/ was untracked

realRepoAcl.note: Measured read-only with Get-Acl; this is the parent ACL that exists before Protect-V4Acl runs.

basic.note: Normal first hardening and idempotency work.

earlyReturn.setup: protected DACL containing CURRENT_USER FullControl plus USERS ReadAndExecute
earlyReturn.note: Protect-V4Acl returns success without removing Everyone/Users/Authenticated Users or verifying FullControl.

denyRule.setup: unprotected explicit deny (Delete) plus allow for CURRENT_USER
denyRule.note: RemoveAccessRule and DACL rewrite removed the explicit deny in this test.

fileLevel.note: After delete/recreate, the file re-inherited the unprotected parent ACL; runtime hardening is not durable.

owner.note: SetOwner is never called; a directory owned by another account is not detected.

failureHandling.note: Save-V4Settings/apply/snapshot ignore the boolean return; no warning is logged.

dpapi.note: ConvertFrom-SecureString uses user-scope DPAPI with no additional entropy; cross-user/cross-machine blobs fail closed but the state path crashes rather than reporting DEGRADED.

settingsAtRest.note: The file inherits a protected config directory after a successful Save; it is not individually protected, and the write happens before the directory ACL is applied.

redaction.note: Synthetic canaries only; no real credential was used.

logging.note: No explicit ACL hardening in Start-V4Log; in the real repo the evidence directory inherits Authenticated Users:Modify and Users:ReadAndExecute.

staging.note: Set-V4Atomic exposes plaintext profile content in the target directory for the duration of validation; cleanup is best-effort.

notExecuted: apply-v4.ps1 / rollback-v4.ps1 / state-v4.ps1 against the real system
faultinject-v4.ps1 (FT12 targets the real hosts file and the harness writes the production lock path)
New-V4Snapshot / Restoration (would stop the live app and touch real profiles)
Cross-user DPAPI decryption attempt (no second account used)
limitations: Synthetic canaries are not real credentials.
ACL tests ran under %TEMP% whose base ACL is narrower than the publish repo ACL; the real repo ACL was measured separately.
The provided fault-injection suite was not run because of its real-system targets.
